content:
maria: Quick async pulse — Q2 OKR milestone check (runtime + model routing). Reply with one line: shipped / slipped / owner / immediate next step. :wave:
ken: Shipped: runtime-v2 canary deployed to eu-west at 08:30. Latency p50/p95 stable vs baseline. :thumbsup:
alex: Slipped: Dedicated autoscale policy (policy engine) — blocked on cloud quota escalation. Moving to next sprint. :grimacing:
sam: Dep: Observability needs to confirm metrics-retention window before we flip default caching. Holding final rollout.
claire: Who owns the canary->prod cut? Product expects an owner for the decision.
ken: I own the canary metrics review + initial go/no-go. Platform SRE owns the final safety gate. I'll post a short signal doc after 24h.
jason: Acknowledged. Platform SRE will watch error budget and latency. Auto-pause rule: if p50 > baseline * 1.12 OR error rate +% exceeds threshold, we'll halt.
maria: Mitigation ask for Dedicated customers: can we run manual capacity bumps if autoscale slips? Need owner for runbook and ops play.
alex: I can author a short runbook. Draft steps:
```
1) Identify customer pool
2) Increase reserved nodes via internal console
3) Notify customer + set timer
4) Revert after X hours
```
Will add required RBAC and billing steps.
beth: Finance OK to approve a one-time quota bump within FY budget. Send estimate of hours and expected GPU hours.
maria: Actions (please confirm):
- ken: finish 24h canary review and post signal doc (ETA EOD tomorrow)
- alex: runbook + RBAC checklist for manual bump (ETA today COB)
- beth: cost estimate approval (ETA EOD)
- product/observability: confirm retention window before final rollout
Also: PR ping — ken: PR #4826 contains kernel fallback; @ryan please review (small change).
ryan: Reviewing now, should be done within 60-90m.
ken: If reviews + canary look good, plan: cut canary->prod tomorrow morning. If anything fails, enable manual bump for affected Dedicated customers and notify CS.
product-bot: Reminder set — follow-up check-in in 24h (thread pinned).
